```{r, setup}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, tidyverse, tidymodels, readr, here, gglm)

data <- read_csv(here("data", "clean_data.csv"))

glimpse(data)
```

# Cleaning

```{r}
snp_cols <- data |> 
  select(starts_with("rs")) |> 
  colnames()

data <- data |> 
  mutate(
    treatment = as.factor(treatment),
    sex = as.factor(sex),
    across(all_of(snp_cols), as.factor),     
    PR = as.factor(PR)        # PR is binary → classification problem
  )

glimpse(data)
```

# Splitting

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Why: split data to evaluate model on unseen data
split_PR <- initial_split(data, strata = treatment)

train_PR <- training(split_PR)
test_PR  <- testing(split_PR)
```

# Workflow

```{r}
recipe_PR <- recipe(PR ~ treatment + age,data = train_PR) |>
  step_impute_mean(age) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

model_PR <- logistic_reg() |> 
  set_engine("glm")

wf_PR <- workflow(recipe_PR,model_PR)
```

# Fit Model

```{r}
fit_PR <- wf_PR |> 
  fit(train_PR)

fit_PR

fit_PR |> 
  extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
  tidy()
```


```{r}

pred_PR <- predict(
  fit_PR,
  test_PR,
  type = "prob"
) |> 
  bind_cols(test_PR)

pred_PR
```


```{r}
class_PR <- predict(
  fit_PR,
  test_PR,
  type = "class"
) |> 
  bind_cols(pred_PR)

class_PR
```


```{r}
class_PR |> 
  metrics(
    truth = PR,
    estimate = .pred_class
  )


roc_curve(
  class_PR,
  truth = PR,
  .pred_1
) |> 
  
  autoplot() +
  
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curve"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
plot_PR <- expand_grid(
  age = seq(
    min(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  ),
  treatment = levels(data$treatment)
)

plot_PR <- plot_PR |> 
  bind_cols(
    predict(
      fit_PR,
      new_data = plot_PR,
      type = "prob"
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_PR, aes(
  x = age,
  y = .pred_1,
  colour = treatment
)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Probability of PR",
    x = "Age",
    y = "P(PR = 1)",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```
